en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3549 - In a narration by Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim, from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) from his father, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), that Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said:
"If a woman apostasizes from Islam, she is not to be killed but is to be imprisoned forever."
